children: Argo Defence Group AB (publ) announces that its wholly owned subsidiary, Disarmament Solutions Ukraine, has been awarded a contract for specialised defence technology with a value of 17 MSEK. Deliveries to Ukrainian end-users are scheduled to take place during 2026 and 2027.
In view of confidentiality and the prevailing security situation, no further information about the customer or the specific contents of the contract will be disclosed.

The contract demonstrates that Argo Defence Group’s targeted investment in Ukraine is now delivering results. It is of particular strategic importance, as it represents the company’s first commercial contract within a new business segment in the country. The contract strengthens Disarmament Solutions Ukraine’s position in the Ukrainian market and establishes an important foundation for continued growth within this segment.

“Argo Defence Group’s operations in Ukraine provide us with direct access to a region with high security requirements and significant demand for defence equipment. Our presence gives us a deeper understanding of local needs and market conditions, enabling faster decision-making, tailored solutions and efficient implementation.

We are now seeing how our substantial investments and long-term market development efforts in the country are creating business opportunities that can make a tangible difference to Ukraine’s defence capabilities.” says Marcus Selme, CEO of Argo Defence Group AB.
Marcus Selme, CEO, Argo Defence Group AB (publ)

This information is information that Argo Defence Group is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-11 09:00 CEST.

Argo Defence Group is a growth-oriented defence group with a focus on customers within both military and civil defence. The Company consists of six subsidiaries: Swedish Net Air & Defence, Disarmament Solutions, Disarmament Solutions Ukraine, Poseidon Diving Group, Zel-Aaren Innovation and LPG Trafikmarkeringar. Argo Defence Group operates through three business areas: Defence Materiel, Counter-Explosive Risk Solutions and Airfield Operations. Together, these business areas enable Argo Defence Group to offer a broad and complementary range of defence-related products and services that contribute to increased resilience and security across the Nordic region, Ukraine and internationally. The Company is listed on Nordic SME, a marketplace operated by Nordic Growth Market (NGM). Learn more at www.argodefence.se
